contract.words: I want to make $6,000 in the next 30 days, and it has to be in one industry: independent auto repair shops. I can put in up to $500.

exclusions: any industry other than independent auto repair shops

strategy.title: Sell 7 owner-built $1,000 websites to independent auto repair shops by cold email and phone, paid up front by Stripe
strategy.why: Shop-specific vendors publish website prices at or above ours: Autoflow charges a $1,000 one-time deposit plus $300/month for website development, Tribute Media's repair-shop template sites start at $2,800. A one-time $1,000 site with no monthly fee undercuts both. The Auto Care Association counts 273,000 US shops, so 7 buyers is a tiny share. Spend is $200 up front plus $40 per site paid from receipts, under the $500 cap. The close rate on cold-contacted shops is the unknown the first 10 days measure.

alternatives.title: One-time Google Business Profile + review-request setup at $500
alternatives.why: Needs 13 sales instead of 7; no shop-specific one-time price is established on its card.

alternatives.title: Monthly local SEO retainer at $600
alternatives.why: Only the first month settles inside 30 days, so 11 clients are needed; retainers close slower than a one-time site.

reviews.reasons: Reviewed the current revision rev_c6465b950e22_990302 (identical in content to rev_f6686a38a356_813f76, which was written against the previous contract digest). Arithmetic and limits hold: net per site $1,000 - $29.30 Stripe - $40 domain/hosting = $930.70; 6 sites = $5,584.20 < $6,000, 7 sites = $6,514.90; up-front spend $200 (pre-proof) and peak exposure $200 are inside the $500 cap, the $40 per site is paid from receipts; first payment day 8 settles by day 22 at worst (7-14 day first payout), shop 7 (day 21) settles day 24, inside 30; the industry exclusion is respected. But the plan is not yet one the owner should act on: (1) validation.decides names only CONVERSION and CURRENT_DEMAND while Brain shows every link unestablished. The $1,000 price rests on Autoflow's monthly add-on list price and Tribute Media's 'starts at' sheet: what vendors charge, not what independent shops pay (the verifier gate rejected both on definitions); the 'undercuts both' argument is not evidence, so OFFER_AND_PRICE must be decided by the test. (2) The test takes $1,000 paid orders before fulfilment is shown possible: the fulfiller is 'the owner, drafting with AI tools' (RECOMMENDATION) and no shop site has been built in 5 days; build one sample shop site first and add FULFILMENT to decides with a stop on late delivery. (3) Owner hours are treated as available: steps need about 38.5 owner hours (15 outreach, 1 offer, 1 test, 7 closing, 14 building, 0.5 collecting) and the goal states none; mark them UNKNOWN and make the owner's confirmation a start condition. (4) MARKET_VOLUME rests on the Auto Care 273,000 figure, which counts all shops (unlabelled), not independents with outdated or missing websites, and was rejected; the s1 list of 300 Google Maps shops is the count to state, and MARKET_VOLUME belongs in what the test measures.
